parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The device name of the device whose desired property values you want to clear.
> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.

parameters.name: Identifies
parameters.description: The list of property identifiers whose desired property values you want to clear. You can specify up to 10 property identifiers.

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The ID of the device whose desired property values you want to clear. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device.
> **IotId** is a globally unique identifier for the device and corresponds one-to-one with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. If you specify **IotId** together with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this value exists, you must specify this **ID** value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or the **ID** value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs whose desired property values you want to clear.
> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
